title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Rider: Meter Test Request Courtesy
content:
A PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) meter error refund carries a test-request courtesy set by the number of meter tests the member asked for on the service account in the twelve months before the current date, counted from the meter test requests in its Electric Service by Rate Schedule records by the date each was reported.

| Meter tests asked for in the twelve months before the current date | Test-request courtesy (USD) |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 15.00 |
| exactly 2 | 7.50 |
| 1, or none | 0.00 |

**Clause.** Where the member asked for three or more meter tests of the service account in the twelve months before the current date, the test-request courtesy is 15.00; where the member asked for exactly two, it is 7.50; with one request it stays at zero.

The twelve months run from the day after the same day of the month twelve months before the current date, through the current date; the fast test itself counts as one of the requests when it was asked for in that period.

Hypothetical counts: requests in January, March and May of the period give 15.00; a request fourteen months ago and one last month give a count of one in the period, so the courtesy stays at 0.00.
